decisions: Independently audit the Gemini 3.8 Flash modernization PR without modifying protected production or dirty legacy checkout.
Reject unsafe or ambiguous patches, enforce root-scoped journaling and version-checked single-file rollback.
Fail closed on unavailable language syntax checks and unconfigured cloud provider requests rather than claim successful validation.
Remove implicit npx and project-controlled executable launches from default formatting and linting; gated local TypeScript checker requires execution permission.
Label repository regex navigation, deterministic review and in-memory fleet task ledger honestly as partial, non-production capabilities.
Package the Windows Job Object PowerShell helper with compiled assets; track assignment before tree termination and check native API success.
Canonicalize journal roots before hashing so macOS /var versus /private/var aliasing does not strand otherwise valid snapshots.
Preserve the canonical requirement stages until independent acceptance evidence exists.

tests.result: 10/10 passed after fixes; original audited branch reproduced 5/5 critical regression failures. Windows-specific process-close test requires Windows CI.

tests.result: roadmap, parity, typecheck, and formatting checks passed; 543 tests passed, 12 platform-specific tests skipped, 27 isolation.test.mjs cases failed solely because the scratch sandbox prohibits Unix-domain socket listen (EPERM). No failures outside isolation.test.mjs were observed. Full suite not green in this constrained environment.
